rows.jp: ……無理だ。

ghs.en: ...ain't happening.

rows.jp: 死を受け入れるわけにはいかない。

ghs.en: Accepting death is just out of the question.

rows.jp: 確かに俺は自分が嫌いだ。
rows.en: It is true: I hate myself.

ghs.en: I hate myself, sure,

rows.jp: すべて嫌いだ。

ghs.en: hate everything.

rows.jp: 自分の醜さ、欲深さが憎らしい。
rows.en: I despise my own ugliness. My greed.

ghs.en: My ugliness and my greed are repugnant.

rows.jp: 霧が抱く憎悪以上の自己嫌悪。
rows.en: A self-loathing deeper than even Kiri's hatred of me.

ghs.en: My self-hatred is no less than the hatred that Kiri has for me.

rows.jp: けど……自殺するならとうにそうしていた。
rows.en: But if I meant to kill myself... I would have done it long ago.

ghs.en: But... if suicide were to be it, I'd have done that already.

rows.jp: 生きるんだ。

ghs.en: I will live.

rows.jp: そうでなければ……なんのために闘ってきたのか。
rows.en: Otherwise... what had I been fighting for?

ghs.en: If I don't... then what have I struggled for?

rows.jp: 生きるために、たとえ霧を……壊すことになっても。
rows.en: I would live, even if that meant... breaking Kiri.

ghs.en: For the sake of living. Even if it ends up... that I break Kiri.

rows.jp: 「……一つ質問なんだけど、屋上で俺と豊がいるのを見たってのは……君？」
rows.en: “...One question. The person who saw Yutaka and me on the roof... was that you?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...just one question, though, who was it that saw me and Yutaka on the rooftop... was it you?"

rows.jp: 「ええ、そうです」

ghs.en: Kiri: "Yes, it was."

rows.jp: 「当時はなんとも思わなかった」
rows.en: “At the time, I thought nothing of it.”

ghs.en: Kiri: "At the time I thought nothing of it."

rows.jp: 「けど……今はわかります」

ghs.en: Kiri: "But... now I understand."

rows.jp: 「トイレでしたみたいに、豊を……追い込んだ」
rows.en: “Just like what you did in the restroom, you... drove Yutaka into a corner.”

ghs.en: Kiri: "Just like what you did in the toilet, you... cornered Yutaka."

rows.jp: 「自分を満たすために！」

ghs.en: Kiri: "Just to fulfill yourself!"

rows.jp: 「どうやって？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "And how?"

rows.jp: 「……豊の脚のことを責めたり……いろいろです」
rows.en: “...You berated him over his leg... among other things.”

ghs.en: Kiri: "...by picking on Yutaka's legs maybe... there's so many ways!"
ghs.assessment: Kiri accuses Taichi of attacking Yutaka over his injured leg or condition. 'Picking on Yutaka's legs' changes the singular issue and trivializes the accusation.

highlights.text: Kiri: "...by picking on Yutaka's legs maybe... there's so many ways!"

rows.jp: 「具体的に聞きたいとは思いません」
rows.en: “I don't want to hear the specifics.”

ghs.en: Kiri: "I do not think I want to hear specifics."

rows.jp: 「もういいですか？」

ghs.en: Kiri: "Are we done?"

rows.jp: 変わらず、手は震えている。

ghs.en: Her hand was shaking, unchangingly.
ghs.assessment: Her hand continues to tremble. 'Was shaking, unchangingly' is an unnatural literalization of 変わらず.

rows.jp: 殺す前に、自分がまいってしまいそうだった。
rows.en: She looked as if she might collapse before she managed to kill me.

ghs.en: It seemed the self would give up just before murder.
ghs.assessment: Kiri looks close to collapsing before she can kill him. 'The self would give up just before murder' loses Kiri as subject and misreads まいる.

highlights.text: It seemed the self would give up just before murder.

rows.jp: 「一つ、いいかな。少し長い話になるけど」
rows.en: “Can I tell you something? It will take a while.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "One more, if I can. It's a tale that'll run a bit long though."

rows.jp: 「……どうぞ」

ghs.en: Kiri: "...go on."

rows.jp: 内心どう思ったのか。

ghs.en: What was she thinking inside?

rows.jp: 感じさせないよう平坦に、霧は言った。

ghs.en: Kiri said that flat, as if not to give off any emotion.

rows.jp: 「……座っていい？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...can I sit down?"

rows.jp: 「どうぞ」

ghs.en: Kiri: "Go on."

rows.jp: 「霧も座ったら？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Will you sit too, Kiri?"

rows.jp: 黙殺。

ghs.en: Killer silence.
ghs.assessment: 黙殺 again means that Kiri ignores the suggestion completely. 'Killer silence' does not express the intentional refusal to respond.

rows.jp: まあいい。

ghs.en: Ah, whatever.

rows.jp: 俺は話し始める。

ghs.en: I begin to talk.

rows.jp: 「支倉って家があったんだ、昔」
rows.en: “There used to be a family called the Hasekuras.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "There was this family called the Hasekuras, long ago."

rows.jp: 「大きな家でさ。洋風で。桐原の家を十倍くらい大きくしたような」
rows.en: “They had a huge Western-style house—about ten times the size of the Kiriharas’.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "They had a big house. Western style. So big it was about ten times Kirihara's house."

rows.jp: 「大富豪ってやつだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Those guys were multi-billionaires."
ghs.assessment: 大富豪 means an immensely wealthy family or magnates. 'Multi-billionaires' asserts a specific modern wealth threshold absent from the source.

rows.jp: 「俺は……幼い頃に母親を亡くして、そこに引き取られた」
rows.en: “When I was little... my mother died, and I was taken in there.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I was... well, when I was a child my mother passed, and I was taken into their custody."

rows.jp: 「そこに住み込みで働く、母親の遠縁にあたる管理人夫妻にね」
rows.en: “By the live-in caretakers—a married couple distantly related to my mother.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I was a live-in worker there, for a manager and his wife who were distant relatives of mother's."
ghs.assessment: The live-in workers were the caretaker couple, distant relatives of Taichi's mother, who took him in. The English wrongly makes Taichi the worker.

highlights.text: I was a live-in worker there

rows.jp: 「古い風習がある家でさ」
rows.en: “The household had customs that went back a long way.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It was a family with old customs, you know."

rows.jp: 「下働きの子供は、やっぱり下働きだった」
rows.en: “A servant’s child was expected to serve too.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "The children of servants were made servants, seriously."

rows.jp: 「俺は子供だったから、家の子供たちの遊び相手みたいな役割だった」
rows.en: “I was a kid, so I more or less served as a playmate for the family’s children.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I was just a child, therefore, my duty was to be sort of a playmate for the children of the family."

rows.jp: 「曜子ちゃんはそこの末娘だった」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Youko-chan was the youngest girl there."
ghs.assessment: 曜子 is the household's youngest daughter. 'Youngest girl there' loses the family relationship and could refer to age among staff or guests.

highlights.text: Taichi: "Youko-chan was the youngest girl there."
